newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler won't comment on new report Werner to go.
newsitem.headline: Daimler won't comment on new report Werner to go.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG and its carmaking subsidiary Mercedes-Benz AG on Thursday declined to comment on a magazine report that Mercedes chief executive Helmut Werner would step down in a management revamp.
"We won't comment on that," a Mercedes spokesman said in response to a Reuter enquiry.
A spokesman for Daimler said, "The supervisory board (of Daimler) will meet on January 23 to discuss the structure as well as people."

"Manager magazine" reported that Werner's departure was agreed in confidential talks in early December between him, Daimler's management board chairman Juergen Schrempp and supervisory board chairman Hilmar Kopper.

Under the planned reorganisation Mercedes-Benz AG will be merged into the Daimler-Benz group, a move which Werner reportedly opposes, the magazine said in a summary of an article to be published in its edition on December 20.
Media and market speculation that Werner could step down has intensified in recent weeks.
